svg.aria-label: About Kyle. I'm Kyle, ImKyleJK online. A self-taught, self-employed developer in Scotland: full-stack apps in Node.js, Svelte and Next.js, interface and logo design, and the Linux infrastructure that keeps it all running. I like small projects that teach me how something actually works, shipped quickly rather than planned to death. Right now: building Rotaaa, rota planning for small teams; running Network Camp, network diagnostics; studying Software development at UHI; contributing Open source with the Contributors Club; writing What I learn, on imkylejk.me/blog
